name: Calumet College of St. Joseph
academic_ranking: Small private Catholic university accredited by the Higher Learning Commission, located in Whiting, IN near Chicago. Offers associate, bachelor, and master programs; serves 1,500+ students per semester. Emphasis on small class sizes, mentorship, social justice, and service learning.
financial_aid: 94% of students receive financial aid; all admitted students are automatically considered for internal scholarships and grants (per ccsj.edu tuition page, checked 2026-07).
facilities_notes: Athletics operates as the Crimson Wave. Softball plays home games off-campus; specific home venue not confirmed on the athletics facilities page (redirected, checked 2026-07). Campus (2400 New York Ave, Whiting, IN) includes Specker Memorial Library, four science labs, and a Student Success Center.
program_reputation: NAIA program competing in the Chicagoland Collegiate Athletic Conference (CCAC). Softball led by Athletic Director/Head Coach Dave Lopez with a multi-person coaching and recruiting staff.
